parent_objective: design a retargeted staged warmup source/outcome route after M1412 sparse positives
blocked_by: M1412 positives are sparse, seed-thin, and wrong-warmup-negative
supersedes: rerunning the same staged gate grid without retargeting
treating source materialization as self-ID evidence

public_gates: M1414 must design a retargeted public source/outcome route before another run
M1414 must preserve collision stratification and wrong-warmup diagnostics
M1414 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune only the 3 M1412 accepted-history seeds

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the next retargeted staged warmup source/outcome experiment to improve seed diversity, near-boundary density, and wrong-warmup sensitivity
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no source smoke, outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design would tune only M1412 accepted seeds
stop if design removes collision stratification
stop if design routes to training/export before source-diverse positives
stop if actor input changes are proposed
fallback_plan: route to mild-gate retune source smoke if a clean retarget is designed
route to branch synthesis if the retarget would be another narrow public loop
pivot away from staged gate if no non-overfit route is credible

training_stage.stage_objective: clear near-boundary staged warmup retarget design
admission_evidence: M1413 blocks training and routes to retarget design
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: source and outcome pass/fail thresholds are pre-registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1414 is design only and must not raise M1412 sparse positives to level3.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no source-diverse retarget is credible, route to synthesis or pivot instead of weakening the evidence standard.
allowed_claims: no source smoke, outcome intervention, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A retargeted staged warmup design can improve source-diverse near-boundary history positives without overfitting to the sparse M1412 accepted seeds.
success_criteria: design preserves collision stratification and wrong-warmup diagnostics
design chooses a next route without source smoke, outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: design overfits to M1412 accepted seeds
design omits collision stratification or wrong-warmup diagnostics
design routes directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1414 passes if it designs a non-training retargeted staged warmup route with pre-registered source/outcome gates and no claim expansion.
